newsitem.title: USA: Tyco prices debt tender offers.
newsitem.headline: Tyco prices debt tender offers.

text.p: Tyco International Ltd said Friday it priced its outstanding tender offers to purchase for cash all of its outstanding 9.50 percent debentures due 2022 and all of its outstanding 8.125 percent notes due 1999.

The company said the purchase price for the 9.50 debentures will be $1,222.90 per $1,000 principal, and the purchase price for the 8.125 notes will be $1,038.82 per $1,000 principal, in each case together with accrued and unpaid interest up to but not including the date of payment.
The assumed date of payment for calculation purposes was July 8, it said.
